# zip.js

`zip.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of `@zip.js/zip.js` version **2.24.0**, under the BSD-3-Clause license in `zip.LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/gildas-lormeau/zip.js

The npm release archive was SHA-512 verified against the registry's integrity value before extraction. This local copy avoids third-party scripts on customer gallery pages. The gallery uses stored entries (no recompression), streaming writes and ZIP64 for collections larger than 4 GiB. No dependency installation or build is needed for the website.
